name: Polymeric Resources Corporation
summary: Polymeric Resources Corporation, along with its affiliated entities, focuses on the creation, production, and sale of advanced engineering thermoplastics. Their extensive product catalog includes a variety of nylon polymers, such as co-polymers, custom-compounded polymers, and specific formulations designed for film, wire, and cable applications. They also supply a comprehensive selection of nylon carpet fibers, encompassing options for post-dyeing in both commercial and residential environments, alongside polymers tailored for fiber extrusion, available in diverse dye shades like cationic, medium, light, deep, and ultra-deep. These specialized materials serve a broad spectrum of industries, including automotive, packaging, wire and cable, injection molding, rotational molding, lawn and garden, power tools, carpeting, and fuel-related sectors. Established in 1976, the company is headquartered in Wayne, New Jersey, and operates additional facilities in New Jersey, Kentucky, and Canada.
